Type: Region
First Visited: Session 0

Description

An independent region bordering the Kingdom of @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.bEFUlWN5ttWk0y59]{Beaconhold}.
Fed by springs and snowmelt from the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.2oPdZNZmUGdavykO]{Bonewall}.
Remote enough that tax collectors don't visit.
The rivers cut through the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.PEnF3AXmLA3UEGGO]{Cragmarr}, providing passage to the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.tLfbM4E64pEL9VF9]{Solvium}.

Notable Features

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.6Eqkl1MNE1055IJC]{Edric Bloom}'s homeland
  • A hamlet on the edge of the kingdom where Edric was born
  • River names have changed at least twice since Edric's birth

Connected Locations

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.bEFUlWN5ttWk0y59]{Beaconhold} — The kingdom to the west
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.2oPdZNZmUGdavykO]{Bonewall} — The mountain range that feeds the rivers
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.PEnF3AXmLA3UEGGO]{Cragmarr} — The rivers cut through this region, providing the only reliable passage to the lake
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.tLfbM4E64pEL9VF9]{Solvium} — The great lake the rivers feed into
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.5ieJV78RD0ZwDQRD]{Havens Reach} — Port town where the Eastern Rivers meet the Solvium

Associated NPCs

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.6Eqkl1MNE1055IJC]{Edric Bloom} — Born in a small village here

Events Here

  • Session 0 — Established as Edric's homeland
